name: AAGB
recent: AirAsia Group Berhad 近期没有重大企业公告，最新公告为董事在闭门期内的交易意向申报。新闻方面，Malaysia Airlines 呼吁在 AirAsia 获得援助时应有公平竞争环境，同时 AirAsia 重申对 Bahrain 的长期承诺并委任当地董事会。
notable: Malaysia Airlines 呼吁若 AirAsia 获得援助，应有公平竞争环境。
AirAsia 重申对 Bahrain 的长期承诺，并委任 AirAsia Bahrain 董事会。
risks: 两名董事在闭门期内表示有意进行公司股票交易。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止期间，营收为 MYR 5,085,584,000，净亏损为 MYR 527,161,000，净利率为 -10.4%。营收环比下降 14.5%，同比增长 669.6%；净利同比变化 -1,596.6%，净利率由上一期的 -2.6% 下降至 -10.4%。

recent_en: AirAsia Group Berhad has no major corporate announcements recently; the latest filings are directors' intentions to deal during the closed period. In the news, Malaysia Airlines called for a level playing field if AirAsia receives aid, while AirAsia reaffirmed its long-term commitment to Bahrain and appointed an AirAsia Bahrain Board.
notable_en: Malaysia Airlines called for a level playing field if AirAsia receives aid.
AirAsia reaffirmed its long-term commitment to Bahrain and appointed the AirAsia Bahrain Board.
risks_en: Two directors indicated intentions to deal in company securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the period ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 5,085,584,000 and net loss was MYR 527,161,000, with a net margin of -10.4%. Revenue fell 14.5% QoQ but rose 669.6% YoY; net income changed -1,596.6% YoY, and net margin declined from -2.6% in the prior period to -10.4%.
